text: The full download fetches pages of 500 products in ascending product-id order using keyset pagination, one page at a time, and only on Wi-Fi. On losing Wi-Fi it finishes the current page and pauses.
An interrupted full download resumes from the last fully saved page, not from page 1.
Changes made during the full download are not lost, and after it the device receives incremental updates in change_seq order (up to 1,000 per response), including deletes.
Incremental sync runs at app launch and on return to the foreground, at most once every 15 minutes.
A 'resync required' answer (position older than the 7-day tombstone window) triggers a new full download, and the existing catalogue stays visible until the replacement is completely ready.
Network and 5xx failures are retried with a backoff that starts at 2 s and doubles, for at most 5 attempts. After that the client waits for the next trigger and keeps the progress it has saved.
Whether reps can browse a partial catalogue during the first download is marked as an open question, not decided.
